visualization_settings.text:
## TEST DATA — Provisional
Simulated attendance date: **2026-11-02**. Current employee and schedule snapshots, not proof of future assignments. Check-in-only checkpoint; checkout has not been loaded. Multi-day attendance counts mean **employee-days**. Missing dates are not zero.

card.description: ATTENDANCE_DAILY_V1. Test data only. Period counts are employee-days. NULL means unavailable or undefined, not zero.
card.name: Organization | Absen Masuk (employee-days)

stages.native:
SELECT SUM(f.checkin_days) AS "Absen Masuk" FROM mart_kehadiran.fact_kehadiran_daily f
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_pegawai p USING(pegawai_key)
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_departemen d USING(departemen_key)
LEFT JOIN serving.attendance_date_state s USING(tanggal) WHERE f.tanggal >= {{start_date}} AND f.tanggal <= {{end_date}}
[[AND f.departemen_id_sumber = {{department}}]]
[[AND (CAST(f.pegawai_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
        OR COALESCE(p.nama,'') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
        OR CAST(f.departemen_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
        OR COALESCE(d.nama,'') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%')]]

card.description: ATTENDANCE_DAILY_V1. Test data only. Period counts are employee-days. NULL means unavailable or undefined, not zero.
card.name: Organization | Department summary — employee-days

stages.native:
SELECT f.departemen_id_sumber AS "Department ID",COALESCE(MAX(d.nama),'Department '||f.departemen_id_sumber::text,'UNKNOWN') AS "Department",SUM(f.active_employee_days) AS "Pegawai Aktif",SUM(f.checkin_days) AS "Absen Masuk",SUM(f.checkout_days) AS "Absen Pulang",SUM(f.no_checkin_days) AS "Tidak Absen Masuk",SUM(f.no_checkout_days) AS "Tidak Absen Pulang",SUM(f.leave_days) AS "Pegawai Izin",ROUND(100.0*SUM(f.checkin_days)/NULLIF(SUM(f.active_employee_days),0),2) AS "Check-in %",ROUND(100.0*SUM(f.checkout_days)/NULLIF(SUM(f.active_employee_days),0),2) AS "Check-out %",ROUND(100.0*SUM(f.required_checkin_present_days)/NULLIF(SUM(f.required_checkin_days),0),2) AS "Required check-in %",ROUND(100.0*SUM(f.required_checkout_present_days)/NULLIF(SUM(f.required_checkout_days),0),2) AS "Required check-out %",BOOL_OR(f.perlu_review OR NOT f.is_date_final) AS "Provisional" FROM mart_kehadiran.fact_kehadiran_daily f
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_pegawai p USING(pegawai_key)
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_departemen d USING(departemen_key)
LEFT JOIN serving.attendance_date_state s USING(tanggal) WHERE f.tanggal >= {{start_date}} AND f.tanggal <= {{end_date}}
[[AND f.departemen_id_sumber = {{department}}]]
[[AND (CAST(f.pegawai_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
        OR COALESCE(p.nama,'') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
        OR CAST(f.departemen_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
        OR COALESCE(d.nama,'') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%')]] GROUP BY f.departemen_id_sumber ORDER BY f.departemen_id_sumber NULLS LAST LIMIT 5000

JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_departemen d USING(departemen_key)
LEFT JOIN serving.attendance_date_state s USING(tanggal) WHERE f.tanggal >= {{start_date}} AND f.tanggal <= {{end_date}}
[[AND f.departemen_id_sumber = {{department}}]]

        OR CAST(f.departemen_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'

SELECT f.pegawai_id_sumber AS "Employee ID",COALESCE(p.nama,'Employee '||f.pegawai_id_sumber::text) AS "Employee",f.tanggal AS "Date",f.departemen_id_sumber AS "Department ID",COALESCE(d.nama,'Department '||f.departemen_id_sumber::text) AS "Department",first_checkin_at AS "First check-in",last_checkout_at AS "Last check-out",has_masuk AS "Check-in",has_pulang AS "Check-out",has_valid_leave AS "Valid leave",has_excused_checkin AS "Exempt check-in",has_excused_checkout AS "Exempt check-out",perlu_review AS "Needs review",NOT is_date_final AS "Provisional" FROM mart_kehadiran.fact_kehadiran_daily f
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_pegawai p USING(pegawai_key)
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_departemen d USING(departemen_key)

card.description: Distinct active employees with at least one valid approved leave in the selected period, divided by distinct active employees in the same department and period. A person can appear in more than one department after a transfer. Test data is provisional.
card.name: Organization | Departments ranked by employees with leave

stages.native:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(d.nama), 'Department ' || f.departemen_id_sumber::text, 'UNKNOWN')
           || ' (' || COALESCE(f.departemen_id_sumber::text, 'UNKNOWN') || ')' AS "Department",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT f.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE f.leave_days = 1)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE f.active_employee_days = 1), 0), 2) AS "Leave %"
FROM mart_kehadiran.fact_kehadiran_daily f
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_pegawai p USING (pegawai_key)
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_departemen d USING (departemen_key)
WHERE f.tanggal >= {{start_date}} AND f.tanggal <= {{end_date}}
[[AND f.departemen_id_sumber = {{department}}]]
[[AND (CAST(f.pegawai_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
    OR COALESCE(p.nama, '') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
    OR CAST(f.departemen_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
    OR COALESCE(d.nama, '') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%')]]
GROUP BY f.departemen_id_sumber
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE f.active_employee_days = 1) > 0
ORDER BY "Leave %" DESC, "Department" ASC
LIMIT 10

visualization_settings.card.title: Top 10 departments by employees with izin (%)

card.description: Distinct employees late on their first recorded shift at least once, divided by distinct employees assessed at least once in the selected department and period. Excused, unassessed and unknown employee-days are excluded. Provisional test data; missing evidence is not on time.
card.name: Organization | Departments ranked by first-shift lateness

stages.native:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(v.nama_departemen),'UNKNOWN') || ' (' ||
       COALESCE(v.departemen_id_sumber::text,'UNKNOWN') || ')' AS "Department",
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT v.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE v.is_employee_active AND NOT v.has_excused_checkin AND v.lateness_status='LATE') /
         NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT v.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE v.is_employee_active AND NOT v.has_excused_checkin AND v.lateness_status IN ('LATE','ON_TIME')),0),2) AS "Late %"
FROM serving.v_lateness_employee_daily v
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_pegawai p USING (pegawai_key)
WHERE v.tanggal >= {{start_date}} AND v.tanggal <= {{end_date}}
[[AND v.departemen_id_sumber = {{department}}]][[AND (CAST(v.pegawai_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
  OR COALESCE(p.nama,'') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
  OR CAST(v.departemen_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
  OR COALESCE(v.nama_departemen,'') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%')]]
GROUP BY v.departemen_id_sumber
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE v.is_employee_active AND NOT v.has_excused_checkin AND v.lateness_status IN ('LATE','ON_TIME')) > 0
ORDER BY "Late %" DESC,"Department" ASC LIMIT 10

card.description: Distinct people per status during the selected period; categories may overlap across dates.
card.name: Organization | Lateness assessment coverage

stages.native:
SELECT 'Assessed: ' || COUNT(DISTINCT v.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE v.is_employee_active AND NOT v.has_excused_checkin AND v.lateness_status IN ('LATE','ON_TIME'))
  || ' · Pending or unknown: ' || COUNT(DISTINCT v.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE v.is_employee_active AND NOT v.has_excused_checkin AND v.checkin_event_count>0 AND v.lateness_status='UNKNOWN')
  || ' · Excused: ' || COUNT(DISTINCT v.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE v.is_employee_active AND v.has_excused_checkin)
  || ' · No check-in: ' || COUNT(DISTINCT v.pegawai_id_sumber) FILTER (WHERE v.is_employee_active AND NOT v.has_excused_checkin AND v.checkin_event_count=0) AS "Coverage"
FROM serving.v_lateness_employee_daily v
JOIN mart_kehadiran.dim_pegawai p USING (pegawai_key)
WHERE v.tanggal >= {{start_date}} AND v.tanggal <= {{end_date}}
[[AND v.departemen_id_sumber = {{department}}]][[AND (CAST(v.pegawai_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
  OR COALESCE(p.nama,'') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
  OR CAST(v.departemen_id_sumber AS text) ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%'
  OR COALESCE(v.nama_departemen,'') ILIKE '%' || {{search}} || '%')]]
